questions.q: Recently which famous historian passed away on 9 March 2026?
questions.explain:
Historian K. N. Panikkar passed away on 9 March 2026.
His full name was Kandiyoor Narayana Panikkar. 
Panikkar served as a professor at Rajasthan University, Delhi University, and the Indian Institute of Public Administration.
